name: Slack
summary: Post messages from Ogun workflows to a Slack channel through an incoming webhook. The webhook URL is the secret.

fields.name: webhook_url
fields.label: Webhook URL
fields.help: The URL Slack gives for the webhook. It is a secret. Store it with ogun secrets set.

operators.summary: Post a text message to the Slack channel the incoming webhook is bound to.

notes: A Slack incoming webhook is bound to one channel when it is created, and anyone holding its URL can post there, so the URL is stored as a secret and never reaches logs, events or lineage. Slack's own rate limits apply.

implementation.evidence: Sink in ogun-export, written from public documentation and checked against a local fake in unit tests; not run against the real service.
